recommendation: Keep this audit commit. Future TestScript manual assertion changes should be made in the Testing FHIR IG source, not by restoring retired core TestScript source; revisit core only if its Testing IG references become stale or misleading.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core TestScript change request to support manual operations or assertions outside test-engine control, with final scope adding manualEval and defaultManualCompletion behavior for manual assertion completion.
initial_application: Core commit ef97bb4874ab7f0db48f039a7fb04e1de5fca230 implemented the request on 2023-01-12 by adding the assert-manual-completion code system and value set, adding manualEval to assert-operator-codes, and adding TestScript.setup.action.assert.defaultManualCompletion with binding and meaningWhenMissing text; that commit is included in v5.0.0.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes on 2022-12-12 assigned Richard Ettema to write the detailed proposal, and minutes on 2023-01-09 recorded the motion to add manualEval plus defaultManualCompletion values fail, pass, skip, and stop. In 2025, commit f9a44787c45071394532c7c2ee94d76f30f47387 removed TestScript/TestReport/TestPlan source from core and added the Testing FHIR IG as the current location for testing resources. Current core fhir.ini and module pages link to that IG, and the current IG package contains the requested manual assertion elements and terminology.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No core source change was made because TestScript is outside the current core build and the requested semantics are already present in the external Testing FHIR IG artifact that now owns TestScript.
